A_runtime.reason: This peer performed source review only. No browser, build, test, or service-error run was launched. Existing warm and reload observations do not establish the service-error dimension; the revised runner still requires a root-owned native run.

B_source.prior_finding: The f6e8dd50 version restored panel connectivity before the controls and could label healthy-network actions as service-error evidence. That source defect is addressed in bb74a496.
B_source.finding: The runner now proves a same-URL panel /health GET returned HTTP 200 with visible OK, then requires net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED and visible FAIL under target-scoped offline conditions. It returns to Debug Log without restoring connectivity, runs natural public-page event generation and the Search, Pause/Resume, Clear, and detail controls while the owned panel target remains offline, then repeats the same failed health ping and visible FAIL before restoration. The public page is a separate browser target.
B_source.evidence_gate: scenarioEvidence can label serviceError only after the initial outage proof. A missing final outage proof clears that flag and downgrades every recorded serviceError dimension to unverified. Existing case predicates still require real matching rows, count changes, details, and empty states; missing positive controls remain unverified rather than fabricated. A control-stage exception during a proved outage is marked fail with a fixed stage, without asserting product root cause.
B_source.restoration: The offline toggle applies only to the owned side-panel CDP target. An outer finally restores online network conditions, cache setting, and Network observation after the battery, including on control failure. Failure to restore is not recorded as success. The disposable profile is owned by the native harness.
B_source.privacy: The health URL stays in memory for equality checks. Error text is compared only to the fixed disconnected code; receipts carry booleans, counts, fixed stages, and categories. The runner does not mock responses, inject log entries, write database data, use Chat/Pilot, or send Source Save input.
B_source.remaining_limits: The health helper is intentionally silent in the Debug event log, so a failed ping alone proves neither a natural error row nor a positive error badge. T17 badge clearing is separately conditional on a badge observed before Clear. Native behavior and actual case outcomes remain unverified until a guarded run.
